question: A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. F sits third to the left of C. Only one person sits between C and P when counted from the left of P. Only two people sit between B and E when counted from the right of E. A is an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits to the immediate left and right of Q, respectively?
solution:
As per the given information.

⇒ A, B, C, E, F, P and Q are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 

⇒ F sits third to the left of C. 

⇒ Only one person sits between C and P when counted from the left of P. 

⇒ Only two people sit between B and E when counted from the right of E. 

⇒ A is an immediate neighbour of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f056a8df967541b27ea84c7056d4a42efc35098f77ca007ed38936f2c8f319.png] 

From the above arrangement, **C & P** are sitting Immediate right and left of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3".**
